drafted_from: tool:open-meeting-link row in tools/open-a-meeting-link/tool-rows.json, read-data/meeting-links.mjs, read-data/meeting-links.json and test/meeting-links.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Open this meeting link for my 10 am call: zoommtg://zoom.us/join?confno=123456789&pwd=hunter2." It reads the link first and, only if its host and parameters are allowed, opens it in the meeting app on your computer.
no_lists_because: It names no list: it takes one link, reads it through the declared meeting routes and hands an allowed link to the system to open.
instructions: 1. Have the meeting app installed on a Mac that has /usr/bin/open and the app registered for the link's scheme (for example zoommtg).

2. Say "Open this meeting link" with the link; your AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:open-meeting-link and input {link}. Use tool:read-meeting-link first if you only want to see what the link would do.

3. Read the answer: opened true with route, action and redacted (the link with secret values hidden), or a refusal that says why the host, action or a parameter was not allowed; a refused link is never opened.
4. Never paste the passcode into notes or logs: the answer shows the link only in redacted form.

worked_examples.title: A join link with a passcode is opened and the passcode stays hidden
worked_examples.given: From tools/open-a-meeting-link/test/meeting-links.test.mjs: the link has scheme zoommtg and host zoom.us, which the zoom-links route allows; its action is join, confno 123456789 matches the nine to twelve digits form and pwd is a secret parameter. Read from read-data/meeting-links.mjs: the redacted form replaces each secret value with three stars. The opening itself needs a Mac with /usr/bin/open.
worked_examples.hands_back: {opened: true, route: "zoom-links", action: "join", redacted: "zoommtg://zoom.us/join?confno=123456789&pwd=***"}; the text hunter2 appears nowhere in the answer. For https://zoom.us.evil.example/join?confno=123456789 it refuses with "host zoom.us.evil.example is not one this meeting app reads" and nothing is opened.
